[[Marik Kuri]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for other items of value.

==Locations==
*[[Shing Jea Island]]
**{{NPC location|Sunqua Vale}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Do you have any idea to whom you are speaking? It is I, Marik, famous author of the "Ten Thousand Tears of [[Tahmu|the Empress]]." What? You have not read my masterpiece? Ah well... it was mostly allegorical. I am sorry to say that I will not be writing any more stories for a while, as I am out of writing quills. I have plenty of feathers but I need mantid pincers to obtain the fine writing point that I require. If you are looking for some work and can bring me 3 Mantid Pincers, I will give you my autograph, and this in return:"''
